# Determinism evidence

# Generated by two identical sessions of the Game Boy machine. Each
# session runs three display frames of the dmg-demo cart and writes a
# PNG screenshot. The two files hash byte-identically.
#
# Session A commands:
#   info
#   run-frame 3
#   read 0xFF40
#   regs
#   screenshot --png ev-a.png
#   save-state ev.state
#
# Session B commands:
#   run-frame 3
#   screenshot --png ev-b.png
#
# demu launch command (both sessions):
#   demu --config sm83-nintendo-gameboy <dmg-demo.gb>

d88a6efba3f7c3598aaffc027ea4ed16562f343f9315b67a7a68ca015d582399  ev-a.png
d88a6efba3f7c3598aaffc027ea4ed16562f343f9315b67a7a68ca015d582399  ev-b.png
